goal: Stop falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing when disk reads or index lookups fail
Return errors on internal storage failures or corruption rather than empty results in RPC and REST endpoints
Properly distinguish pruned or downloading blocks from missing transactions
agreement: Broad agreement on distinguishing missing transactions from internal read or index failures
Support because treating internal failures as missing data is incorrect (ryanofsky, yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Nonblocking suggestions and a question on handling unclean shutdown leftovers remain open (ryanofsky)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because index corruption and read errors are explicitly surfaced rather than treated as missing data
Alerts users immediately to potential storage or index corruption so it can be investigated and repaired

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC and REST endpoints will no longer falsely report confirmed transactions as non-existent
Prevents downstream clients and automation from taking erroneous actions based on false negative responses
Distinguishes pruned or downloading blocks from internal disk read errors
